sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Govt. Of U.P. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Akhand Pratap Singh,Adarsh Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard Sri Anurag Mishra and Sri Akhand Pratap Singh, learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.163 of 2024, under Sections 376, 306, 506,
385 IPC and Section 67 of IT Act, Police Station Kotwali, District Pratapgarh.

3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was lured into love by the applicant and subsequently, physical relations were also formed and a video was made viral and on account of the said, the daughter of the informant committed suicide by coming in front of a train.
Lavkush vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84172549/

entities.text: Lavkush vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 The applicant was linked for the offences under Sections 376 IPC, 306, 506, 385 IPC read with Section 67 of IT Act.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that the postmortem report does not corroborate the allegation of rape and there is no material to suggest abetment at the instance of the applicant for being implicated under an offence under Section 306 IPC; the abetment as defined under Section 107 of IPC is prima facie missing and considering the law as explained in the case of Mariano Anto Bruno and another vs Inspector of Police; 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1387 coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 25.04.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

entities.text: Mariano Anto Bruno and another vs Inspector of Police; 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1387
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Lavkush be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
